label: Jesse Michels
narrative: Jesse Michels is the single most consequential independent interviewer in the modern disclosure movement and the reason this domain exists as a structural rather than anecdotal problem. A Thiel Capital investor who built the YouTube series American Alchemy, Michels has done what legacy outlets did not: he gave multi-hour, unedited platform time to the people who claim to know how the recovery and reverse-engineering effort is actually organised, and he pushed them to draw the org chart. On 11 January 2026 he published 'The Pentagon's UFO Program Is Real [Here's How It Works!]' with the researcher UAP Gerb - a three-hour-thirteen-minute structural reconstruction whose own description states the thesis plainly: 'This is not one program. It is a layered, compartmentalized system that grew out of the Manhattan Project, the Atomic Energy Commission, and Cold War intelligence structures.' Its chapter list is effectively a table of contents for the alleged architecture: 'The Pyramid of Contractors', 'Modern Majestic 12', 'The Administrators of Secrecy', 'The Office of Global Access', 'The Role of MITRE', 'The DOE NEST', 'The 1954 Atomic Energy Agreement', 'The Y-12 Complex'. That episode has 514,729 views. Michels had already run the same researcher a year earlier (21 February 2025, 'The New Area51 Is HERE in Utah!', 450,091 views), which toured Air Force bases, deep underground facilities and 'Federally Funded Research Organizations' associated with reverse engineering. He broke Jake Barber's crash-retrieval account on 30 January 2025 to over a million viewers, sat with Michael Shellenberger on 14 November 2024 the day after Shellenberger delivered the Immaculate Constellation report to Congress, and on 8 March 2026 put Eric Davis in a room with Eric Weinstein for a four-hour session that worked through the Wilson-Davis memo. Michels' method is the point: he does not adjudicate, he platforms at length and lets the structural claim accumulate in public, where it can be indexed, dated and cited. That is why the structure is now discussable at all.
